PUNKIN ALE – A Beer Beloved Since 1994:

One of the craft beer industry’s first pumpkin beers, Punkin Ale (7.0% ABV) is Dogfish Head’s full-bodied Brown Ale brewed with real pumpkin meat, brown sugar and baking spices. Chock full of smooth hints of pumpkin and brown sugar, it is the perfect beer to warm up with as the weather cools. Part of Dogfish Head’s Season-ALES series, this year’s iteration of Punkin Ale features new artwork by Brooklyn-based artist, Dylan Goldberger.
Punkin Ale is available now from coast-to-coast on draft and in 6pk/12oz cans, as well as within Dogfish Head’s “Pass the Aux” seasonal variety pack.
“PASS THE AUX” VARIETY PACK – A Music-Themed Mash-Up:

Built for cozy, fireside nights with friends, Dogfish Head’s “Pass the Aux” Variety Pack is a 12pk/12oz can assortment of four fall-flavored beers. In addition to Punkin Ale, it includes three cans of each of the following variety pack exclusive brews.
NEW!

Favorite Sweater (6.5% ABV): An honest-to-goodness American India Pale Ale (IPA) billowing with hoppy notes of rustic pine and bright citrus wrapped in layers of bready Munich and toffee-rich caramel malts.

Indian Brown Ale (7.2% ABV): A cross between a Scotch Ale, an IPA and an American Brown Ale, this dry-hopped, Dark IPA is brewed with aromatic barley and organic brown sugar for malty, caramel-y flavors of coffee and dark bread crust.
Namaste (4.8% ABV): A Belgian-style White Ale brewed with dried orange slices, fresh-cut lemongrass, peppercorns and coriander for a zesty and slightly sweet beer bursting with good karma.
This 12pk/12oz can package is now available in select states from coast-to-coast.
XOCOLATL WORLD WIDE STOUT – A New Iteration of a Long-Time Libation:

Offering a new, off-centered take on Dogfish Head’s iconic World Wide Stout, Xocolatl World Wide Stout (15% ABV) is a dark, rich and roasty Imperial Stout aged on roasted cocoa nibs, whole Madagascar vanilla beans, cinnamon verum quills, Cobanero chilis and black Urfa chilis. The result is a full-bodied sipper with notes of chocolate, vanilla and a complex blend of earthy, fruity and gently spicy chilis that is sure to warm the soul.
In states where legal, Xocolatl World Wide Stout will be available on draft and in 4pk/12oz bottles beginning in early October.
PUNKIN LIQUEUR – A Full-Proof Spirit Distilled from Punkin Ale:

Distilled from Dogfish Head’s Punkin Ale, Punkin Liqueur (30% ABV) is aged in used Dogfish Head rum barrels for sweet notes of oak and molasses. It is then finished with a flush of cinnamon, nutmeg, allspice, ginger, vanilla, dark brown sugar and a touch of sage. Perfect on its own, added to a classic cocktail recipe, or dropped in coffee, cider or hot chocolate for some extra seasonal goodness, Punkin Liqueur is available at Dogfish Head’s coastal Delaware locations, only while supplies last.
To learn more about Dogfish Head’s beers and spirits, please visit www.dogfish.com. To track down these fall-favorites, check out the Fish Finder.

DOGFISH HEAD CRAFT BREWERY:

With quality, creativity and non-conformity at its core, Dogfish Head has been committed to brewing unique beers with high-caliber culinary ingredients outside the Reinheitsgebot since the day it opened more than 31 years ago. Dedicated to exploring goodness of all kinds, Dogfish Head later expanded its beverage artistry beyond just craft beer to produce award-winning portfolios of full-proof spirits – whiskeys, gins, vodkas, rums and more – and spirits-based, ready-to-drink canned cocktails. A Boston Beer Company brand and proud supporter of the Independent Craft Brewing Seal, Dogfish Head is a Delaware-based entity consisting of Dogfish Head Craft Brewery, a production brewery and tasting room; Dogfish Head Distilling Co., a production distillery; Brewings & Eats, a brewpub and live music venue; Chesapeake & Maine, a seafood and cocktail spot; and the Dogfish INN, a beer-themed, canal-front hotel. For more about Dogfish Head, please visit www.dogfish.com or follow the brand on social media.
